Subject: Sparrow Accelerator — emergency pilot top-up & escrow invoicing

Hi Jordan,

Quick note — we ran out of our pilot credits yesterday in the middle of demo week. We have 30 active teams that still need access for the next 6 weeks; total incremental consumption estimate is ~550k tokens (embeddings + generation).

Is there a way Redwood can do a temporary top-up so the cohort can finish the program without interruptions? Our programs team prefers not to ask startups for credit cards mid-program. Two billing paths we could accept: 1) Redwood invoices Sparrow Accelerator and we settle (net30), or 2) Redwood accepts an escrowed payment from our sponsor and draws down against it.

We'd also like to keep the cohort on the promotional pricing you provided during the initial onboarding (20% off list) through the remainder of the cohort, and discuss whether we can convert remaining credit to a discounted committed package if we decide to continue after the program.

Attached: Sparrow_MOU.pdf (MOU with cohort list redacted)

Can you let me know the fastest path? We can sign a one-off amendment today if needed.

Thanks,
Mara Clifton
Director, Partnerships
Sparrow Accelerator

Hi Mara / Jordan,

Thanks — Naomi on finance. We can support both paths; outline below is what we typically do for accelerator pilots:  

Option A — One-off invoice (fastest)
- Fixed top-up invoice for estimated consumption (you pay upfront or net30).
- We provide weekly consumption reports; any material overage is invoiced at month-end.
- Promo pricing: we can extend the 20% promotional discount for the remainder of the cohort (up to the value of the estimated top-up).

Option B — Escrow drawdown (preferred for sponsor-funded cohorts)
- Sponsor transfers funds into escrow; Redwood draws down per reported consumption.
- We require a short sponsor letter and a PO number.
- Promo pricing: we can keep 20% promo locked for the funded amount; conversion to committed reserved capacity requires a new commercial commitment.

Commercial specifics (proposal):
- Top-up amount suggestion: $2,400 (estimated to cover ~550k tokens with promo applied).
- Overages billed monthly at standard list rates (we'll cap monthly overage to a pre-agreed % if you want protection).
- Legal: no new T&Cs beyond a short amendment; we can route via DocuSign.

Attached: pilot_topup_quote.xlsx (line-item quote and invoice templates).

If this structure works, Jordan — can you confirm the final cohort list and whether we should set per-team caps? Mara — if you can share sponsor PO or the sponsor contact, we'll send an invoice/escrow instructions today.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

1) We want the promotional 20% to apply for any drawdown from the escrow up to $2,400 (as you proposed).
2) If Sparrow decides to convert remaining credit to a committed reserved package within 90 days, can the top-up amount be credited toward first invoice for a committed 6-month package (we'd expect a modest conversion discount, e.g., additional 10% off committed rates)?

If you can confirm those two items and send a short amendment + invoice/escrow instructions, we'll get sponsor PO and sign today.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — demo day is this Thursday.
